🔥 PokeTokenBar | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with an engaging and visually intuitive way to track their AI coding token usage and associated costs within a macOS menu bar application.
✨ Key Features: • Visualizes AI token usage as Pokémon companions • Tracks token spend, cost, and official 5-hour/weekly limits • Reads usage data directly from local logs (no external CLI needed) • Hatches, evolves, and collects Pokémon based on token usage
📖 Summary: PokeTokenBar is a macOS menu bar application that visualizes AI coding token usage by raising and evolving Pokémon. It tracks token spend, costs, and usage limits directly from local logs, providing an engaging way to monitor AI tool consumption.
